fusions.name: Spark Shower
fusions.desc: Strikes hot iron and throws sparks through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 fire damage with a 70% chance to leave each enemy hit [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: The Quench
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The blow deals 22 damage and puts out every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times the damage they had left to deal.

fusions.name: Slag Runnel
fusions.desc: Pours a line of slag 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Forge-Hot Head
fusions.desc: Conjures a maul with a glowing head. Your weapon damage rises by 12% and your fire resistance by 10%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
